card.name: University names in science news
card.fires_on: The last word of a university or institute name in science press-release text, such as State after North Carolina, Berkeley after UC, or University after Tel Aviv. Also a few news-site and dateline punctuation marks.

modes.label: University name endings
modes.description: The closing word of a university or institute name naming the researchers' affiliation.
modes.example: researches nanoparticle drug delivery at North Carolina<< State>> and University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill

modes.label: Press-release headers
modes.description: Site names or punctuation in the header and dateline of a science news item.

card.plain: It marks the end of a university or institute name in a science news story.
